## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not directional risk-on/off. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Tech leadership (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%)) and Cyclical vs Defensive ↑ rising (level up) alongside VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -7.47%) complacency — mixed signals align with ROTATION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ (HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +0.55%), LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.14%)) shows tension in credit ratios. Reflation forces strong: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +9.81%) and Gold RECOVERY (GLD RECOVERY (1W: +4.81% | 1M: -0.57%)) drive rotation dynamics.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing: Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +8.81%); TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.71%)) and Dollar strength → flat (Dollar BELOW TREND) leave conditions supportive but watch credit spreads CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading sharply: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%) showing strength. Financials showing weakness: Financials / XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.33%), Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?
US strength intact: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +8.81%). EM and China catching up: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.91% | 1M: +12.10%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +3.37%), Europe lagging (Europe vs US ↓ falling).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation rising: Speculation Index ↑ rising and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +11.81%) with ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +15.50%) — small cap IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +9.20%) confirms appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/reflation bid: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +9.81%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.29% | 1M: +12.91%) showing strength. Gold RECOVERY (GLD RECOVERY (1W: +4.81% | 1M: -0.57%)) acting as hedge amid rotation.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed-to-weak: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -8.50% | 1M: +16.44%) show short-term pullbacks inside a longer reflation backdrop; Natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +4.18%) stronger.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership (XLK and SOXX both ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: Major divergence in energy/commodity ETFs (BNO/UGA/USO showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) plus TLT RECOVERY (1W/1M mismatch) — suppress aggressive single-regime plays.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor tech and semiconductors (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%)) while reducing exposure to Energy and Utilities (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -3.88%)); monitor credit spread moves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology/semis (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%)). BEARISH: Energy and Communications (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40%), XLC CORRECTION (1W: -0.45% | 1M: +1.43%)) if short-term weakness persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +9.81%)). BEARISH: Brent/WTI short-term corrections (BNO CORRECTION (1W: -8.50% | 1M: +16.44%), UGA CORRECTION (1W: -3.26% | 1M: +22.91%)) — watch weekly flows.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 28.47 (complacency; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -7.47%)), HYG/LQD 0.7342 (credit stress ↓), Tech vs Financials 3.48 (XLK/XLF level ↑ rising), SPY/TLT 8.64 (stocks vs bonds ↑ rising).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, led by tech and semis while financials and utilities lag. XLK and SOXX showing strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%)); key risk is major divergence in energy/commodity names and credit ratio deterioration (HYG/LQD ↓).
